response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile senior full-stack engineer with deep experience in TypeScript, Node.js, DLang, and web/mobile platforms, but he lacks the core mandatory requirements for this role: no meaningful C++ development on Windows, no fixed income/derivatives or capital markets domain experience, and no SQL Server/Oracle depth. His brief C/C++ exposure at National Instruments (2014-2015) is minor and outdated, and his career has moved entirely away from C++ since then.
strengths: Strong, broad senior/staff-level software engineering background
Demonstrated CI/CD, TDD, and DevOps practices across multiple roles
Excellent communication skills evidenced by talks, workshops, and open-source leadership
concerns: No current or recent hands-on C++ development, and none on Windows platform
No exposure to fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domains
No SQL Server or Oracle experience; only lightweight MongoDB/MySQL usage listed

key_factors.factor: No capital markets/fixed income domain exposure
